results.title: Cascading effect: On dams and land rights
results.content: India must respect land rights of its people while building dams

results.title: 36 hospitalised after eating at Mumbai wedding, food poisoning suspected
results.content: The Maharashtra food safety body, led by Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe, was alerted after the guests, including four children, fell ill.

results.title: IPL retention deadline extended to November 17
results.content: The extension is understood to have been prompted by the India-New Zealand ODI series, with the fifth and final match scheduled to be played on November 15

results.title: Clean energy investments helped India soften West Asia crisis impact: PM Modi
results.content: Inaugurating Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo, Narendra Modi says India’s economy continued to grow despite the crisis; warns that excess dependence on fossil fuels could risk increased exposure to global disruptions

results.title: HPCL Visakh Refinery supports Educational initiative on India’s Freedom movement
Air quality of Delhi slips to ‘very poor’ for first time this winter, Stage 2 of GRAP invoked
results.content: AQI of Delhi stood at 324 (very poor) at 4 p.m. on November 2, up from 261 (poor) a day earlier; NCR State governments to enhance vehicle parking fees to discourage use of private vehicles, staggered timings to be introduced for public offices and municipal bodies; Delhi Metro to run 20 more trips on weekdays

results.title: Three AAP leaders join BJP ahead of Punjab Assembly election
results.content: Amritsar North MLA Kunwar Vijay Pratap, Sanour MLA Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra and Samana MLA Chetan Singh Jauramajra join the BJP in Delhi; State BJP president Kewal Singh Dhillon says it indicates the impending end of the party’s regime in Punjab
